Unexpected news from [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] today as a familiar face greets us: our own.

Recently, the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesAdj] have become captivated by our form. Something about our [Species.GetEarNamePlural] seems to remind them of their young. summary.text:
# 填充[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]玩具 / Stuffed [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:8176-8308`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:468, 538-560`（on_five_year_random_pulse_pre_ftl）；`events/on_action_events_2.txt:3146-3179`（action.620/621）

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 每五年的国家检查运行 action.620：拥有“首次接触”DLC、且与某个前超光速文明有生效协议的普通帝国，会在 0–360 天后抽取“前超光速外交事件池”（无事 200，本事件 10，条件不满足的事件被跳过）。
  The five-year country pulse runs action.620: a regular empire with the First Contact DLC and an active agreement with a pre-FTL civilization draws from the pre-FTL diplomacy pool 0-360 days later (nothing 200, this event 10; events whose conditions fail are skipped).
- 条件：拥有观测哨站，境内有已完全知晓我们的被观测前超光速文明（非蜂巢、非本国“挣脱桎梏”母族）；15 年内不重复。
  Conditions: we have an observation post and an observed pre-FTL within our borders that is fully aware of us (not a hive, not our Broken Shackles parent); not again for 15 years.
- 发生后设置“近期前超光速外交事件”冷却，其他此类事件暂不出现。
  Afterwards a "recent pre-FTL diplomatic event" cooldown blocks the other events of this pool for a while.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 7500「填充（我方物种）玩具」：他们觉得我们“可爱”，市面上满是夸张的我方毛绒玩具。
  7500 "Stuffed (our species)": they find us "cute"; exaggerated plush toys of us are everywhere.
- 选项依我方特质与思潮出现：当然可爱（无“丑陋”特质）；（排外）我们不可爱；（丑陋/恐怖谷特质）结结巴巴的否认；（不重视他者）浪费时间；（非巨企且重视他者）能给我们一个吗？；（巨企）收取肖像权费。单页事件。
  Options by our traits and ethics: "of course we are" (not repugnant); (xenophobe) "we are not cute"; (repugnant / uncanny robots) a flustered denial; (does not value others) "a waste of time"; (non-megacorp valuing others) "could we have one?"; (megacorp) "royalties on our likeness". A single window.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 这是可重复抽取的随机外交插曲之一（各事件本身每个帝国通常一次），与同池其他事件没有固定顺序。
  One of the random diplomacy interludes of this pool (each usually once per empire), with no fixed order relative to the others.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无额外的文明差异分支。
  No further empire-specific variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发与六个选项的条件。
  Checked: trigger and the conditions of all six options.
